technologies.name: Automated Extraction
technologies.description: Unlock extractors that harvest a field within one hex.

technologies.name: Composition
technologies.description: Unlock component composers and the landing objective path.

technologies.name: Storage Planning
technologies.description: Optional branch that unlocks exact-quantity containers.

technologies.name: Material Processing
technologies.description: Unlock the smelter and the kiln, and with them plate, glass, brick, and charcoal.

technologies.name: Mechanical Shaping
technologies.description: Unlock the cutter and the crusher, which turn wood and stone into timber and gravel.

technologies.name: Hydrology
technologies.description: Unlock the pump, so a basin becomes a reason to build beside it.

technologies.name: On-site Power
technologies.description: Unlock poles and the burner generator, so a region can afford to run.

technologies.name: Sited Generation
technologies.description: Unlock wind on the ridges and hydro at the basin edge.

technologies.name: Steam Works
technologies.description: Unlock the boiler and turbine pair. Water rides belts; this is not a fluid network.

technologies.name: Corner Transport
technologies.description: Unlock the riser, which carries cargo along all six vertex headings between the ordinary hex edges.

technologies.name: Machine Tiers
technologies.description: Unlock the deep extractor and the deep container, and the upgrade that grows one into the other in place.

technologies.name: Transmission
technologies.description: Unlock the relay pole, and the upgrade that grows a pole into one in place. A wider disc means fewer poles between the plant and the work.

technologies.name: Grid Engineering
technologies.description: Unlock the trunk pole, which spans twelve hexes to the next. A line of them reaches a site too far to give its own generator.

technologies.name: Shallow Crossings
technologies.description: Unlock stone-and-timber bridge decks for carrying transport across shallow water.
